final: WITH freq_stats AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) as avg_signed_amt, AVG(t.balance) as avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.frequency), mean_signed AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amt) as mean_amt FROM freq_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT freq_stats.* FROM freq_stats, mean_signed WHERE freq_stats.avg_signed_amt > mean_signed.mean_amt) SELECT AVG(above_mean.avg_signed_amt) as avg_signed_average, AVG(above_mean.avg_bal) as avg_balance_average, AVG(above_mean.avg_signed_amt - (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amt) FROM freq_stats)) as avg_excess FROM above_mean
